About Us
One Agency.
Every Dimension.

MDA — Master Digital Agency is a full-service commercial agency operating in Dubai and the UAE. We build, design, produce, automate, and deliver — across Digital, Creative, Media, and Business Solutions.

Backed by the infrastructure, talent, and technology of DREXONYX, MDA brings enterprise-grade capability to businesses at every stage — from first website to full digital operation.

We are not a freelancer marketplace or a template shop. Every project is strategically scoped, professionally executed, and supported from launch day and beyond.

Powered by DREXONYX

MDA operates under the DREXONYX brand umbrella — a Dubai-based creative and technology studio. DREXONYX provides the engineering systems, creative infrastructure, and operational backbone that powers every MDA engagement.

Project Workflow
From Brief to
Delivered.

Every MDA project follows a disciplined four-stage process — designed to reduce client effort, eliminate ambiguity, and produce work that performs from day one.

We don't start building until the brief is clear. We don't deliver until the work meets standard. At every stage, you have a named contact and a defined next step.

DISCOVER DESIGN BUILD DELIVER
01
Discover
Goals & Strategy

We map your business goals, target market, and commercial opportunity in a structured discovery session. The outcome is a written brief that defines deliverables, confirms audience, and locks the project timeline. Nothing moves to design until the brief is finalised and signed — removing the ambiguity that derails most agency-client relationships before they begin.

Business brief & scope Competitor analysis Fixed project timeline Target audience map Success criteria
02
Design
Visual & UX

Every touchpoint is crafted specifically for your brand — visual identity, UX wireframes, and messaging aligned to your audience and sector. We present three design directions before any build begins. Nothing proceeds to development without your written approval — the gate is hard, not negotiable, and protects your budget from rework.

Wireframes & layouts Visual identity assets Client approval gate UX flow diagrams Brand guidelines
03
Build
Execution

We execute across all disciplines simultaneously — frontend development, content setup, production, and media creation delivered on brief and on schedule. Parallel execution shortens project durations without quality trade-offs. Weekly status updates keep you informed at every stage without requiring hands-on involvement from your side.

Frontend development CMS & content setup QA & testing Cross-browser validation Production sign-off
04
Deliver
Launch & Support

We manage the full go-live — DNS, hosting configuration, and deployment to your confirmed infrastructure. On launch day you receive the complete codebase, all creative assets, and a written handover brief. Every MDA project includes 30 days of post-launch support as standard; ongoing maintenance tiers are available for clients requiring regular updates beyond that window.

Full codebase handover DNS & hosting setup 30-day post-launch support Admin access & training Post-launch review

Why DREXONYX × MDA
The Case for MDA.

The UAE market has no shortage of agencies. What it lacks is one that combines genuine technical depth, commercial pricing, and a reliable delivery standard — without requiring an enterprise budget.

Enterprise Infrastructure at Commercial Rates

MDA is powered by DREXONYX — a technology and creative studio with production infrastructure, AI systems, and engineering capability typically reserved for enterprise clients. You get that backbone at package pricing.

Fixed Scope. Fixed Price. No Drift.

Every engagement is scoped upfront with defined deliverables, timelines, and a single fixed price. There are no retainer traps, scope-creep invoices, or ambiguous hourly billing.

Built for UAE Business Reality

MDA is designed for the industries, clients, and commercial context of the UAE — not adapted from a Western template. Our demos, packages, and workflows reflect how business actually works here.

Deliverables, Not Promises

Every MDA project ends with a complete, handed-over deliverable — not an ongoing dependency on our tools. You own what we build, and we document it for continuity.

Results, Not Reports

We measure success against the original brief — not against activity metrics. Every project closes with live, working output deployed and confirmed against its stated objectives.

Four Disciplines. One Relationship.

Digital, Creative, Media, and Business Solutions — all under one agency. No vendor management, no brief-by-brief contractor juggling. One point of contact. One standard across every deliverable.

Support That Outlasts the Launch

Every MDA package includes post-launch maintenance. The Professional and Premium tiers provide ongoing rounds of updates — so the work you receive stays live, current, and functional as your business evolves.

Speed Without Compromise

MDA's production infrastructure enables rapid turnaround without sacrificing output quality. Most projects move from signed scope to first deliverable within seven working days.

A DREXONYX Brand

MDA is the client-facing agency brand of DREXONYX. Every project, regardless of package tier, is executed by the same team, to the same engineering and creative standard.
